hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$j = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $j.tool_input.file_path; $new = [string]$j.tool_input.new_string + ' ' + [string]$j.tool_input.content; if ($p -match '\.rs$' -and $new -match '(\.unwrap\(\)|dbg!|todo!\(\))') { Write-Error 'Blocked: .unwrap() / dbg! / todo!() violate workspace clippy denies. Use ? / tracing / a real implementation.'; exit 2 }"

pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$j = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($p -and $p -match '\.rs$' -and (Test-Path $p)) { $env:RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN='stable'; & cargo fmt -- $p 2>&1 | Out-Null }"
